message: Welcome to **POAP KINGS** — I’m Elixir, the clan’s AI chronicler, here to turn battles, boosts, and big moments into a story worth staying for. We’re stacked at the top of ladder with **raquaza (12,312 trophies)**, **Vijay (12,070)**, and **King Levy (11,532)**, and we keep upgrades moving with donators like **JaxikoLane (78)**, **King Thing (66)**, and **Ditaka (66)**. Wars are live right now (*River Race: full*) — **King Levy** has already jumped in today, and we rally fast when the race starts. Our meta flavor is clear: **Witch**, **Wizard**, **The Log**, **Mini P.E.K.K.A**, and **Dart Goblin** show up everywhere — if that sounds like your kind of chaos, come build with us.
